Calculate the thermal-mismatch strain in the aluminum film bonded to a ceramic substrate using the formula ε = (α_f − α_s) × ΔT.
Use α_f = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ for the aluminum film.
Use α_s = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ for the ceramic substrate.
Use ΔT = 180 K representing a cooling process.
State that because α_f > α_s, cooling causes the film to contract more than the substrate, putting the film in biaxial tensile strain.
Report the result as ε = (23×10⁻⁶ − 8×10⁻⁶) × 180 = 15×10⁻⁶ × 180 = 2.7×10⁻³ (i.e., 0.27%).
Note that this is an estimate assuming the film is sufficiently thin that it does not significantly constrain the substrate (substrate acts as a rigid constraint).
